exposure: number of previous cesarean sections (first CS vs. repeated CS)
cohort: The study included 130 women, equally divided between those undergoing their first cesarean section and those undergoing repeated cesarean sections.
finding: Anxiety was significantly higher in women undergoing repeated cesarean sections compared to those undergoing their first cesarean section.
mod_finding: Anxiety was significantly higher in women with repeated cesarean sections compared to those with a first cesarean section.
